purpose: Teach: あいかわらず/おまかせ/さがし/わかれ/しるし/さながら/すごし/段々

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、あいかわらずお絵描きが上手いのよ
lines.en: Sho, you're getting better and better at drawing, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm observation with a smile in the voice. Soft, unhurried. A gentle acknowledgment—noticing without making a fuss of it. Relaxed posture, the tone of someone who loves watching small progress.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、デザートはメイ姉さんのおまかせでいいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, can I just have whatever you think is good for dessert?
lines.style: Open, trusting tone. A child's eagerness wrapped in politeness. Quick, light delivery. Seeking approval but already hopeful of the answer.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと一緒にお花をさがしましょうね
lines.en: Come on, Sho. Let's go look for flowers together, yeah?
lines.style: Gentle invitation. Warm and unhurried, with the tone of someone creating a small pocket of safety. Slight rise on the question—drawing him in. Soft, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとわかれる時、寂しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… when I'm not with Dad, it feels lonely.
lines.style: Quiet, vulnerable confession. A child's honesty with no filter. Spoken carefully, as if testing whether he's allowed to feel this. Trailing softly—waiting for reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きにメイ姉さんのしるしの星を付けてあげる
lines.en: I'll put my special star mark on your drawings from now on, okay?
lines.style: Tender promise. Spoken with quiet intention—this is deliberate, this matters. Soft but certain. The tone of someone creating a small ritual that means something bigger.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りの賑わいがさながら夢みたいだったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the way the festival was so crowded and bright—it felt like a dream.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. A child processing something beautiful. Slow, thoughtful pace. Slight lift on 'dream'—not quite sure how to hold onto it. Reflective, not quite present-tense.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんとゆっくり一緒にすごして嬉しいわね
lines.en: I'm so happy we get to spend quiet time together like this, Sho.
lines.style: Genuine contentment. Spoken with the ease of someone exactly where she wants to be. Warm, unhurried. A soft exhale of relief underneath—this moment matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き段々上手くなってきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think I'm getting better at drawing now.
lines.style: Quiet pride. A child's careful confidence—not boasting, just reporting progress he's noticed in himself. Slight lift at the end, seeking confirmation. Sincere and young.
